**Finding: INSURANCE — compliant (preferred).**

Section 18 of the Brightline agreement already carries a full Vendor insurance programme that satisfies every preferred element:

- CGL: USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate (§18.1)
- Professional E&O: USD 2,000,000 (§18.1)
- Cyber and privacy liability: USD 5,000,000, granted unconditionally — so the "if Vendor processes Customer Data" trigger is covered for this hosting vendor (§18.1)
- Workers' compensation as required by law (§18.1), plus employer's liability of USD 1,000,000 as an extra
- Certificates of insurance on request (§18.2)

Section 18.2 adds Customer-favourable mechanics (reputable insurers, primary coverage, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and insurance not limiting Vendor's liabilities). No redline proposed — the clause sits at or above our preferred position, and no other provision waives or dilutes it.
